title: Interconnection Application Terms by Rider — Net Energy Metering
content:
This schedule lists, for each Net Energy Metering rider, the interconnection review level, the application fee, the time allowed to complete a deficient application, the review period, and the insurance and disconnect-switch requirements an applicant must certify.

## Review level and fees

| Rider | Interconnection review level | Fixed application fee (USD) | Additional fee per kW AC (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rider NEM-L Legacy Net Energy Metering | Level 1 inverter-based, 25 kW and below | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Rider NEM-R Residential Net Energy Metering | Level 1 inverter-based, 25 kW and below | 75.00 | 0.00 |
| Rider NBT-R Residential Net Billing Tariff | Level 1 inverter-based, 25 kW and below | 75.00 | 0.00 |
| Rider NBT-C Commercial Net Billing Tariff | Level 2 fast track, above 25 kW through 150 kW, or Level 1 at 25 kW and below | 145.00 | 1.00 |
| Rider NEM-A Aggregated Net Energy Metering | Level 2 fast track through 1,000 kW | 800.00 | 2.00 |
| Rider NBT-L Large Customer Net Billing Tariff | Level 3 study process above 150 kW | 1500.00 | 2.00 |

## Timelines and certifications

| Rider | Business days to complete a deficient application | Business days for review of a complete application | Minimum general liability insurance (USD) | Lockable external disconnect switch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rider NEM-L Legacy Net Energy Metering | 10 | 15 | 0.00 (none required) | Not required |
| Rider NEM-R Residential Net Energy Metering | 10 | 15 | 0.00 (none required) | Not required |
| Rider NBT-R Residential Net Billing Tariff | 10 | 15 | 0.00 (none required) | Not required |
| Rider NBT-C Commercial Net Billing Tariff | 10 | 20 | 1000000.00 | Required |
| Rider NEM-A Aggregated Net Energy Metering | 10 | 40 | 1000000.00 | Required |
| Rider NBT-L Large Customer Net Billing Tariff | 10 | 60 | 2000000.00 | Required |

## Notes

- An insurance minimum of 0.00 means no insurance certification is required under that rider.
- The three business riders require both an insurance certification and a lockable external disconnect switch; the three residential riders require neither.
- Every rider allows 10 business days to complete a deficient application; review periods differ by rider, from 15 to 60 business days.
